content.text: Java is a class-based, object-oriented programming language which is platform-independent.
: everything in java lives inside a class. No lose functions, no code floating around.
: you model your program as objects that have data(fields) and behaviour(methods).
: compiled java code requires JVM to interpret it. Thus, any platform which has JVM installed can run java code.

blocks.code:
Main.java
    │
    ▼
javac
    │
    ▼
Main.class (Bytecode)
    │
    ▼
JVM
├── Class Loader
├── Bytecode Verification
├── Interpreter
└── JIT Compiler
    │
    ▼
Machine Code (Binary)
